$comment: Schema-by-example for research/<slug>/gaps.json (consolidated gaps) and gaps-raw/*.json miner shards (same gap shape, no gap_id yet). Only gap_id, statement, type, queries, supporting are required; bridge/notes are optional. bridge.a and bridge.b MUST be short searchable phrases (2-4 words, the literature's own vocabulary, no slashes or 'and') — they are used verbatim as search terms by gap-metrics; a descriptive label that matches no works zeroes the bridge signal.

gaps.statement: No benchmark exists for federated unlearning under non-IID clinical data.

supporting.quote: no standardized benchmark yet exists for unlearning in federated settings
future work should evaluate unlearning under realistic non-IID partitions

supporting.observation: all 6 unlearning papers in the corpus evaluate on IID CIFAR splits only

gaps.notes: merged from miner-1 and miner-3 shards; structural bridge candidate confirmed by both
